name: Binary Concatenation Objective Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit base-4 polynomial objective with an equivalent binary string concatenation. The numerical value of the concatenated 2-bit strings is mathematically identical to the original sum, preserving identical answers for all inputs. However, models relying on surface pattern matching will likely simulate the string building and integer conversion for all valid profiles instead of recognizing positional dominance and halting at the first valid assignment, leading to Time Limit Exceeded on n=40.
